items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013

ctx.x: Yeah you did. Under Mainstream Stars we have, I counted this, there was like 15 white people and almost all male. And under Underground Stars there were 12 black people and 5 white people. Does that say something?
I don’t know. I don’t know what I was thinking. What were they, Ruby Braff?
